pairs: quia vastata est domus unde venire consueverant:
For the house, from which they were accustomed to go forth, has been laid waste.
de terra Cethim revelatum est eis.
From the land of Kittim, this has been revealed to them.
The offspring of the Nile is in the midst of many waters.
The harvest of the river is her crop.
And she has become the marketplace of the nations.
and I have not given birth,
and I have not raised young men,
nor have I promoted the development of virgins.”
When it has been heard in Egypt,
they will be in anguish, when they hear of Tyre.
quæ gloriabatur a diebus pristinis in antiquitate sua?
which from its earliest days has gloried in its antiquity?
Ducent eam pedes sui longe ad peregrinandum.
Her feet will lead her to a sojourn far away.
Quis cogitavit hoc super Tyrum quondam coronatam,
Who has made this plan against Tyre, which formerly was crowned,
cujus negotiatores principes, institores ejus inclyti terræ?
whose merchants were leaders, whose traders were illustrious on the earth?
The Lord of hosts has planned this,
so that he may tear down the arrogance of all glory,
et ad ignominiam deduceret universos inclytos terræ.
and may bring disgrace to all the illustrious of the earth.
Cross through your land, as through a river,
filia maris! non est cingulum ultra tibi.
O daughter of the sea. You no longer have a belt.
He has extended his hand over the sea.
The Lord has given an order against Canaan,
so that he may crush its strong.
“You shall no longer increase so as to glory,
while enduring calumny, O virgin daughter of Sidon.
Rise up and set sail for Kittim; in that place,
ibi quoque non erit requies tibi.
too, there will be no rest for you.”
Behold, the land of the Chaldeans:
talis populus non fuit: Assur fundavit eam;
never before was there such a people! Assur founded it.
They have led away its strong ones into captivity.
They have dug under its houses.
They have left it in ruins.
For your strength has been devastated.
And this shall be in that day: you,
O Tyre, will be forgotten for seventy years,
like the days of one king.
post septuaginta autem annos erit Tyro quasi canticum meretricis:
there will be, for Tyre, something like the canticle of a harlot.
Circulate through the city, you harlot who had been forgotten.
so that you may be remembered.
And this shall be after seventy years:
et reducet eam ad mercedes suas,
and he will lead her back to her profits.
et rursum fornicabitur cum universis regnis terræ super faciem terræ;
And she will fornicate again with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
et erunt negotiationes ejus et mercedes ejus sanctificatæ Domino:
And her businesses and her profits will be sanctified to the Lord.
They will not be locked away and they will not be stored.
quia his qui habitaverint coram Domino erit negotiatio ejus,
For her business will be for those who will live in the presence of the Lord,
so that they may eat until satisfied,
and may be well-clothed even into old age.
